## secure-terminal fuzz seed corpus.
##
## One seed per line: NAME<space>HEX. Hex keeps the file pure ASCII, so
## hostile bytes (C1, bidi, zero-width, combining runs) survive review and
## the repo-wide non-ASCII gate.
##
## Two consumers, deliberately sharing one corpus:
##   - .clusterfuzzlite/build.sh explodes it into $OUT/<harness>_seed_corpus.zip
##     so the atheris fuzzers do not cold-start from empty each run.
##   - dist-ai test_fuzz_harnesses.py drives every harness over it on each
##     push, so a harness that raises is caught by the gate, not a nightly.
##
## Each harness reads these bytes through its own FuzzedDataProvider, so one
## seed exercises a different shape in each.

## ---- seeded FROM THE ADVERSARIAL CORPORA ------------------------------------
## The three sanitizer corpora (dangerous / Trojan-Source / git-diffs-lie) and the
## 22 live terminal-poc-corpus payloads, as fuzz seeds. They were one-shot fixtures:
## each ran through render_output once and was never mutated or combined, so the
## coverage-guided fuzzers started from bytes that had nothing to do with the real
## attacks. stdisplay-tests already seeds its fuzz from dangerous_corpus(); this
## suite claimed to mirror it and the wiring was missing.
##
## build.sh explodes every line here into $OUT/<harness>_seed_corpus.zip, so all
## seven atheris harnesses now START from real attacks and mutate outward -- and
## test_fuzz_harnesses.py drives them over the same seeds on every push.
